description:
`Interactive.render/1` concatenates the full transcript into a
line list with no windowing and no word-wrap. Long sessions
overflow the visible screen; long assistant messages >
terminal width soft-wrap inconsistently.

Upstream parity: tui-render.test.ts (port-map §14.5) covers
viewport math — content shrinkage, scroll-up on overflow,
cursor-tracking on shrink, transition empty→content, spinner
middle-line detection. Port each scenario.

Design:
- A Viewport that takes (transcript, input_height, term_height,
  term_width) → list of lines fitting in (term_height -
  input_height).
- Word-wrap each transcript message at term_width, ANSI-aware
  (don't count escape codes in width). Upstream has
  wrap-ansi.test.ts (port-map §14.3) — port those scenarios.
- Scroll: when total_rendered_height > available_height, keep
  the tail (most recent). Rough equivalent of a read-only
  scrollback; no keyboard scrolling for MVP.

TDD:
- short session fits on screen with no wrap
- long assistant message wraps at width; ANSI preserved
- transcript exceeds height → only tail visible
- shrinking transcript (e.g. streaming replaces earlier text
  via MessageUpdate) updates viewport correctly
- wide-char lines (CJK) wrap at grapheme boundaries, not bytes

Pure functions — no GenServer. `Interactive.render/1` calls
into Viewport and gets the already-windowed lines ready for the
Renderer.
title: Transcript viewport abstraction + word-wrap
